annotations.title: Wallet Risk Card (OFAC + address checks + approvals)

description: One compact JSON risk card for a wallet before you pay, trust or interact with it: OFAC SDN sanctioned yes/no, address checks (burn/zero, EOA vs contract vs EIP-7702 delegation, fresh/empty), open ERC-20 approvals summary (unlimited, unknown or sanctioned spenders), 0-100 risk score + A-F grade, flags, sources and timestamp. Read-only. $0.02 per card, no free tier. No free tier; $0.02/call via x402 (MCP params._meta["x402/payment"] or HTTP) or X-API-Key credits. Failed calls are not charged.

address.description: 0x address or ENS name to score
